title: BUGFIX — Code-demo pipeline crashes with 'No code to explain' when Ollama returns empty
rationale: code-demo pipeline (P2) fails on every batch run: callOllama() returns empty string (Ollama unreachable or returns null response), codeToExplain stays empty, throws 'No code to explain'. Fix: (1) wrap callOllama in try-catch to prevent unhandled throws, (2) add hardcoded Python fallback before the throw at line 146 so code-demo always produces content.

tasks.description: In scripts/scs001/code-demo-scriptgen.ts: (1) Wrap callOllama() body in try-catch returning '' on error so it never throws. (2) Before the 'throw new Error(No code to explain...)' at line 146, add a fallback that generates a minimal Python snippet using the topic name (input.prompt or 'Python automation'). Log a warning '[code-demo] LLM unavailable — using template fallback'. This ensures code-demo always produces something even when Ollama is down.
